answer.rationale: The daily transfer limit is a business invariant on money leaving an account. It is enforced in the application service using a constant defined there (DAILY_LIMIT_CENTS), not in Account.withdraw or a value object. Account only checks positivity and sufficient funds. The sent-today figure comes from the repository, but the decision itself is not a uniqueness-style cross-aggregate check. The aggregate should own this rule.
